questions.question: Verify the institutions and dates of the chairs: the source assigns mathematics in 1850 and mechanics in 1857 to the Collège de France; check whether the mechanics appointment was at a different institution.

localizations.source: Verify the institutions and dates of the chairs: the source assigns mathematics in 1850 and mechanics in 1857 to the Collège de France; check whether the mechanics appointment was at a different institution.
localizations.ru: Уточнить учреждения и даты кафедр: исходник относит математику 1850 года и механику 1857 года к Коллеж де Франс; проверить, не относится ли механика к другому учреждению.

questions.resolution: Clarified: the mathematics chair was at the Collège de France (1850), while the mechanics chair was at the Faculty of Sciences in Paris (1857).

questions.question: For the special Riccati equation y′ + ay² = bxᵐ, provide in both editions a verified list of the exponent values m corresponding to the integrable cases previously found by Daniel Bernoulli. Check the normalization and list against Liouville’s 1841 paper: https://www.numdam.org/item/JMPA_1841_1_6__1_0.pdf .

localizations.source: For the special Riccati equation y′ + ay² = bxᵐ, provide in both editions a verified list of the exponent values m corresponding to the integrable cases previously found by Daniel Bernoulli. localizations.ru: Для специального уравнения Риккати вида y′ + ay² = bxᵐ привести в обеих редакциях проверенный перечень значений показателя m, соответствующих случаям интегрируемости, ранее найденным Даниилом Бернулли. Сверить нормировку и перечень с работой Лиувилля 1841 года: https://www.numdam.org/item/JMPA_1841_1_6__1_0.pdf .
